response.rationale: Both translations are accurate for the stated shopping sense. “Tas kertas” is an ordinary Indonesian expression and “beg kertas” an ordinary Malaysian expression. The different-common-word relation is valid for localized forms, although the English loan “paper bag” is also used in both varieties. No false-friend contrast is present or required.
